definition: Whether a Tobii eye-tracking file was found and read for this participant-task.
Estimated device sample rate in Hz from LSL timestamps.
Task/window duration covered by the eye-tracking samples.
Fraction of samples with gaze_valid == 1.0.
Fraction of valid samples where gaze_x or gaze_y falls outside [0, 1].
Mean horizontal gaze position (normalised scene camera, 0=left, 1=right).
Mean vertical gaze position (normalised scene camera, 0=top, 1=bottom).
Standard deviation of horizontal gaze position on valid samples.
Standard deviation of vertical gaze position on valid samples.
Mean Euclidean distance of each valid gaze sample from the per-window centroid.
Mean frame-to-frame gaze displacement per second (normalised units/s) on valid samples.
95th-percentile frame-to-frame gaze velocity; proxy for peak saccade rate.
Mean binocular pupil diameter (mm); pairwise mean of available left/right values.
Standard deviation of binocular pupil diameter (mm).
Linear trend of binocular pupil diameter per second (mm/s).
Fraction of samples where binocular pupil diameter is NaN.
Within-window range of binocular pupil diameter (max − min, mm).
Mean absolute first-difference of pupil diameter per second (mm/s); proxy for dilation rate.
Mean left-eye pupil diameter (mm).
Mean right-eye pupil diameter (mm).
Standard deviation of left-eye pupil diameter (mm).
Standard deviation of right-eye pupil diameter (mm).
Fraction of samples where left-eye pupil diameter is NaN.
Fraction of samples where right-eye pupil diameter is NaN.
Mean absolute left–right pupil difference (mm); proxy for anisocoria or asymmetric tracking failure.
Estimated blink count: runs of consecutive invalid samples lasting 0.05–0.40 s.
Estimated blink rate in blinks per minute.
Mean duration of detected blink-like invalidity gaps (s).
Within-participant change in mean pupil diameter relative to T0 baseline (mm).
Z-score of pupil mean relative to T0 baseline, normalised by T0 standard deviation.
Whether blink detection was possible. True when gaze_valid_frac >= 0.70 (uses gaze transitions) or >= 0.99 (uses pupil-NaN fallback). False when gaze_valid_frac < 0.70.
Semicolon-separated machine-readable QC flags; 'ok' means no flag fired.
Human-readable plain-language description of each QC flag.
